name: ai-news-analyzer
description: Scrapes AI news, summarizes with an LLM, displays on a portal, and emails a weekly digest.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run server:dev" "npm run client"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.postinstall: node -e "console.log('Run: npm run install:all to also install client deps')"
